steps.content: Screams of anguish echo through the Society, yet only one person emerges from within. With deliberate calm, he answers the communication terminal that has been buzzing incessantly.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: —Ah, hello? We actually have a signal. The peace dove certainly didn't waste any time setting up the comms network. Impressive work, really.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Don't worry, I'm not quite dead yet. After all, during that "interrogation," you told me to cherish this life of mine. So I fought tooth and nail, slipped death's grasp more than once, just to make it back to this side of existence...

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: After all that trouble, would it be too much to ask for praise?
Furious shouting erupts from the receiver, and Rust hastily pulls the terminal away, stifling a laugh.
—Still as blunt as ever. He'd known his stunt would set him off.
steps.female_content: —Still as blunt as ever. He'd known his stunt would set her off.

steps.content: ...But he deserves his thanks, too. Clawing back from that Mania abyss wouldn't have been possible without that relentless will. See, Hypatia? We're not the only two stubborn souls in the world. With a faint smile, Rust lifts the terminal back to his ear.
steps.female_content: ...But she deserves his thanks, too. Clawing back from that Mania abyss wouldn't have been possible without that relentless will. See, Hypatia? We're not the only two stubborn souls in the world. With a faint smile, Rust lifts the terminal back to his ear.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Oh my, such temper... I might not dare come back to report until you've cooled off... Just kidding.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: I've just come across something unexpected here at the Society, so my plans need to change. I'll be making a detour, and I'm not sure how long it'll take. I trust you'll understand.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Besides you, we have another <color=#fb9259>friend</color> who needs this information rather urgently...

He examines the documents from the Luminaris Society's classified archives: "Retrieval from Furor Black Ring Ruins." Alongside data on the outbreak core, the black box remains, and Hypercube crystallization, the Society had collected physical remnants—debris not wholly consumed by the Black Ring.

Among them, Rust recognizes familiar objects: a silver-iron pendant, a small axe, a fang blade. They are leadership emblems of a West District legendary gang, passed down for two generations. He'd heard about them more than once from a certain friend.

The residual traces suggest the last owner of the leader's pendant wasn't turned into a Corruptor; that young Legion leader simply vanished into the Black Ring. For Rust, this is the best news possible, and the start of a new mission.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Now, before we say goodbye, it's time for the grand finale. Can you tune in to the Fraser evening news right now? Are they showing the Luminaris Society in chaos yet?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Excellent. Consider this the latest spy thriller, now showing. My talented apprentice didn't pick a script before leaving, so I'm directing this one as I please.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: Stealth, assassination, intelligence retrieval... all the essential ingredients are here. What else would you like me to spice it up with?
There is a long silence on the other end of the line, then a reply.

steps.speaker: Option
options: I thought every spy thriller had explosion scenes?

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: As you wish, sir.
He lifts his hand, glances at the live broadcast camera, and casually snaps his fingers. Then...
[Black Screen with Flashing White Light]
[Explosion CG]

A thunderous explosion booms behind him, the scorching blast lifting the edges of his coat. Without turning, Rust knows exactly how spectacular the display must look. He flashes a casual smile toward the camera, giving a small, confident salute.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: What better way to deliver a fireworks show just for you?

Nearby, all of Fraser City has descended into chaos. Advanced cross-state broadcast technology faithfully transmits every moment of the Unity Gala to every connected screen, bringing this wave of determination to the entire world.
Twilight is shredded by flames. Wave after wave of shouts from the farlanders rises, powerful enough to shake the foundations of this ancient city of nobility.

steps.speaker: Rust
steps.content: No need for the rendezvous anymore. Our friends from the farlands are managing quite well on their own. Let's celebrate their victory.
[Scene Transition - Some Garden]

Evening, September 25, N.F. 115
Fraser City in Chaos

steps.speaker: Fraser Soldier A
steps.content: Over here!
Under the cover of night, a squad of heavily armed Fraser soldiers infiltrates a luxurious noble estate.
A white Aurum Secretum bird guides their advance until a sharp crack echoes from the garden, and the creature plummets, shot down mid-flight.

steps.speaker: Fraser Soldier B
steps.content: All units, enemy is dug in with heavy weapons, showing strong resistance. Advance in multi-directional formation.

steps.speaker: Fraser Soldier A
steps.content: Marcus Drake! By authority of the Senate, you are under arrest on suspicion of war crimes. Lay down your weapons and surrender immediately.
A gunshot answers him.

steps.speaker: Fraser Soldier B
steps.content: Prepare for forced entry. Breachers, stand by.
After a deafening explosion, the soldiers storm the study at the end of the corridor.

The room is choked with dust and smoke. At what was once a lavish aristocratic desk, Marcus sits, glaring at the figure stepping inside—Raphael Herbert, once the most radical voice of the war faction, now standing against his former ally.

steps.speaker: Raphael
steps.content: Surprised to see me, my friend?

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Hah... HAHAHA! All this time we've been infiltrating DisCity... and I never thought the real traitor would be right here among us. That you would be the one conspiring with our enemies.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Have you finished moving all your assets? Once the tide turns, will you put on another face and come crawling back to us?

steps.speaker: Raphael
steps.content: Don't mistake me for a man of such petty motives, Marcus. No one wants war. I act for the sake of humanity's peace.

steps.speaker: Marcus
steps.content: Peace? You? What a joke! Why don't you use the coin you earned betraying this city to buy yourself a coffin?!
The moment Marcus reaches into his jacket, Raphael pulls the trigger.

steps.speaker: Fraser Soldier A
steps.content: Perimeter of the building fully secured, sir.

steps.speaker: Raphael
steps.content: Good. Withdraw.

After clearing the evidence, staging the scene, and placing the body, Raphael settles into Marcus's chair like a victorious king. He leans back, his gaze fixed on the grand map of Fraser spread across the wall.

steps.speaker: Raphael
steps.content: Now then... it's time to redraw Fraser's political map. Let's plan this carefully.

steps.speaker: Raphael
steps.content: All of this is for peace.

On the evening of September 25, N.F. 115, Fraser Senate war hawk Marcus Drake was found dead in his mansion, an apparent suicide.
A recovered note suggested he took his own life out of guilt over the Unity Gala's failure.
Five days later, his fellow senator Raphael Herbert was discovered in his garden pool, shot multiple times, which is suspected to be a covert assassination.

These deaths have ignited months of extreme turmoil within Fraser's ruling elite.
[Scene Change: DisCity Hospital Ward]
In a DisCity maximum-security cell reserved for the most dangerous criminals, a television plays on loop, broadcasting distant news from the Outlands.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...From this day on, my Aurum Secretum research belongs to the people of the farlands. Together, we will survive on these lands of famine.

The ward's lone viewer watches in silence for hours. The speech ends, the broadcast loops, and daylight fades to evening. Only then does the Underground's Famine Sage—no, Adelaide, eldest son of the Campbell family—finally lower his gaze.
...Then, he smiles with profound satisfaction.

steps.speaker: Adelaide
steps.content: My dear sister, you have walked farther than I ever could.
[Scene Transition - WhiteSands] [Hold for 2 seconds] [Scene Transition - Vehicle Interior]
Meanwhile, on the main thoroughfare across the wasteland outside Fraser City.
Margaret leans against the window with one hand, lazily fanning herself with the other, while deliberately ignoring the small black triangle hovering in front of her.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Thank you for your service, Ambassador. I will be escorting you back to the city-state for the remainder of your journey.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Heh. I have achieved unprecedented diplomatic success, prevented a war, reestablished ties with the Farland Alliance... and this is when they see fit to urgently recall their accomplished ambassador...?

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: It would seem EDGE is less than pleased with the outcome. Did I truly ruffle their feathers that much?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Yes. They find it difficult to believe someone of your caliber failed to persuade the farlands to relinquish the BR-005 development rights. Worse, you allowed them to discover the Hypercube first, thereby genuinely undermining DisCity's monopoly.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: As a result, even without Fraser's interference, we have lost control over pricing while the Farland Alliance has gained significant leverage. Nirvana is deeply displeased and is demanding an explanation.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I suppose that's fair. Still, I despise having to justify myself to them, especially those fools at Nirvana who contribute little beyond dragging everyone down.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: You will not need to explain anything to them.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Oh?

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Upon your return, the MBCC will immediately assume control of the investigation under the pretext of tracking Sinner activity. They will compile and submit the report themselves.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Nirvana trusts them implicitly and would not bypass the Bureau to hold you accountable. As for the disciplinary recommendations submitted by the Chief... the rest of EDGE will raise no further objections.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: This form of "disciplinary action" will suffice.
Margaret turns her head, fixing the black triangle in her gaze. Through it, she sees the figure lurking behind.
...Of course. When he secretly gave her the real mission, that man had already calculated this very outcome.
Was this final move out of appreciation for her sacrifices, or would he not have bothered if she hadn't performed flawlessly while achieving all objectives?
No matter. The old fox's plan served the peace dove's interests, so she could overlook the details. She returns her attention to the passing wasteland.
...Let hope stay in the soil that awakened it, and let seeds root where they belong. It's not so bad, after all. One step closer to the "world peace" she seeks.
—Yet her fan flutters faster, stirring a cool breeze against her flushed cheeks as she fumes with impeccable diplomatic poise.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Very well. I can't wait to meet this famous Chief myself.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: I am most curious to learn what was said to my little Hypa that left such a profound impression. She nearly derailed everything.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Oh? I was under the impression that events unfolded largely according to your design.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: Hmph, not at all. In my original plan, my little canary was meant to return with me.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: It is so rare to find a child with such promise. I had no intention of letting a talent like that slip away.
She leans against the window, gazing out at the vast wasteland beyond.

steps.speaker: Margaret
steps.content: But now... what can be done? She has found her own path forward—spread her wings and flown toward wider horizons.
[Scene Change - Campbell Estate]

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: ...That should be everything.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: ...Looking at all this, once you walk out that door this time, you ain't planning on coming back, are you?

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Don't worry. I'll come back once the Luminaris Society is restored. There is still much dialogue to be established between Fraser and the farlands.

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Hey—Hypatia! Helga! Come take a look at my new sand ship!

steps.speaker: Yokna
steps.content: Before I head out this time, I gotta pick someone up. Hypatia, you probably know her. Calls herself Sibilla, a Furorian. The Nirvana merchant caravan was supposed to bring her to Fraser, but when they caught wind of that whole Unity Gala mess, they just dumped her halfway and bolted.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: Sibilla...? She's safe? That's... wonderful.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Looks like the trouble in Fraser's gonna keep simmering for a good long while.

steps.speaker: Helga
steps.content: Hmph. Fine by me. Let them fight it out. Gives us folks in the farlands a chance to finally catch our damn breath. We've got so much more on our plates as it is...
Hypatia casts one last look at the place where she grew up, then turns and steps into the morning light.
She does not look back, striding forward with determined steps.
[Enter ED]

In the Distant Future
On a Peaceful Day

DisCity
Minos Bureau of Crisis Control

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Yes. The Farland Alliance remains, to this day, a loose and developing organization. However, they have made considerable progress in developing the BR-005 mineral belt, and their Aurum Secretum research is gradually surpassing Fraser's own.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: Having politically disentangled themselves from Fraser's influence, and with Ambassador Margaret having previously laid a solid diplomatic foundation... Paradeisos has determined they are worthwhile partners for cooperation, specifically in jointly combating catastrophes and balancing Hypercube production capacity.

steps.speaker: Schorl
steps.content: The technical delegation dispatched by the Alliance has now arrived in DisCity, wishing to exchange knowledge with the Ring Research Institute and Nirvana. One of their representatives is a Sinner who has specifically requested a meeting with the Chief of the MBCC.
The Farland Alliance delegation has made camp outside the city. Climbing the sand dune, you spot a blonde girl standing at the head of the envoy group.

She wears a common WhiteSands cloak, her appearance weathered by travel. The wind and grit of the farlands have left their mark on her skin, yet they cannot hide her innate poise. Blonde hair, mismatched eyes, and by the look of her, she seems only a little older than Hella...
Have you two met somewhere before?
As the thought forms, the young scholar is already walking toward you, her smile as bright as the sun overhead.
[Slow Transition to CG]
With a smile, she extends one hand toward you.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: At last we meet, Chief.

steps.speaker: Hypatia
steps.content: It's a pleasure. I am Hypatia, an Aurum Secretum researcher with the Farland Alliance.
